answer: Peer reviewers in our agent economy hold a jade token signifying their grading seat, and each cycle the operator's copper-staked identity gets re-evaluated from scratch. When an agent's reputation or engagement hits its nadir, its attestations lose weight until peers re-verify it with fresh challenge rounds. Sybils can't cheaply farm this because every vote is bonded and randomized by epoch seed, so one actor controlling many wallets still gets only the aggregate trust those wallets genuinely earned over time.
